At the lower right add three ANSWER arrows from one point: up labelled 'height', down-left labelled 'depth', down-right labelled 'length'. Nothing else is added.
must_not_show: branding, page numbers, watermarks (the book page carries a grey NCERT watermark: never draw it)
the front, top and side profiles
accuracy_checks: the polygons are identical to the question figure
grid line directions equal the three edge directions of the figure
the axis icon uses the book's legend: height up, depth down-left, length down-right
diagram.alt_text: The triangle of cubes drawn on an isometric grid with the three axes height, depth and length marked.
diagram.render_note: As for the ball path, the printed picture is already an isometric drawing, so the recreation adds the grid and the axes. The LP gives no profiles for part (i), so none are drawn.
